rules.title: SF Rent Ordinance annual allowable rent increase (3/1/2026–2/28/2027)
rules.requirement: For covered rent-controlled units in San Francisco, the maximum annual rent increase is 1.6% for the period March 1, 2026 through February 28, 2027.
rules.quoted_span: Allowable Rent Increase: 1.6% for March 1, 2026 – February 28, 2027
rules.effective_date_note: Start of the rate period stated in the document.

unverifiable_exemptions: Exemptions under the Rent Ordinance (e.g., units built after 1979, single-family/condo exemptions under Costa-Hawkins) cannot be verified from parcel data

rules.title: SF Rent Ordinance § 37.9C relocation payments (3/1/2026–2/28/2027)
rules.requirement: Tenants evicted for owner/relative move-in, demolition/permanent removal, temporary capital improvement work, or substantial rehabilitation must receive $8,245 per tenant, up to $24,733 per unit, plus $5,497 for each elderly, disabled or minor-child household member, for notices served 3/1/26–2/28/27.
rules.key_value: $8,245 per tenant; max $24,733 per unit; +$5,497 per elderly/disabled/child household
rules.effective_date_note: Start of the adjusted rate period for notices served on or after this date.

rules.title: SF Rent Ordinance § 37.9A Ellis Act relocation payments (3/1/2026–2/28/2027)
rules.requirement: Tenants evicted under the Ellis Act must receive $11,110.05 per tenant, up to $33,330.13 per unit, plus $7,443.90 for each elderly (62+) or disabled tenant, for notices served 3/1/26–2/28/27.
rules.key_value: $11,110.05 per tenant; max $33,330.13 per unit; +$7,443.90 per elderly/disabled tenant
rules.effective_date_note: Start of the adjusted rate period.

rules.title: SF security deposit interest rate (3/1/2026–2/28/2027)
rules.requirement: Landlords must pay interest on tenant security deposits at 4.2% for the period March 1, 2026 through February 28, 2027.
rules.quoted_span: Security Deposit Interest: 4.2% for March 1, 2026 – February 28, 2027
rules.effective_date_note: Start of the rate period stated in the document.
rules.conflict_note: The document does not cite the specific code section for the interest requirement; the alias is not stated in the document.

parsed.doc_summary: SF Rent Board current-rates page for 3/1/2026–2/28/2027: 1.6% allowable rent increase, 4.2% security deposit interest, and updated relocation payment amounts under Rent Ordinance §§ 37.9C and 37.9A. Other items (capital improvement rates, Rent Board fees) are not separate in-scope rules.
